title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 01/27 — "The Eve of the War"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 1. No one would have believed, in the last years of the nineteenth century, that this world was being watched keenly and closely by intelligences greater than man's -- minds that looked across the gulf of space with envious eyes and slowly drew their plans against us.

At Ottershaw, in the round observatory under the stars, the astronomer Ogilvy lets a young writer look through the great telescope at the little red planet, while a jet of flame rises from its limb for the tenth night running. Then home at midnight along the dark road to Maybury, his wife on his arm, the stars above them -- and nobody in England yet afraid of anything at all.

Chapter I of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
